subject: Edge-Hosted Private Deploy: Preflight & Account Setup Action Plan
messages:
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@finnova.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, priya.natarajan@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Edge-Hosted Private Deploy: Preflight & Account Setup Action Plan

Alex — thanks again for choosing Redwood for your private deployment. Attached is a short preflight we use to validate VPC/on-prem environments and accelerate rollout (r_inf-preflight-checklist.xlsx). I also attached an example network diagram (network-diagram-vpc.pdf).

High-level asks to unblock the next steps:
- Complete the preflight sheet with your VPC details (primary CIDR, subnets, NAT/egress patterns, expected concurrency, and region/provider).
- Confirm whether this will be: (a) customer VPC with peering, (b) customer VPC with PrivateLink, or (c) on-prem air-gapped installation.
- Provide account IDs and contact for cloud infra (IAM admin) so we can propose the least-priv privilege IAM role or service account.
- If you plan to use a customer-managed KMS/HSM, please send key ARNs and KMS admin contacts.
- Network requirements we typically need: outbound HTTPS to Redwood control plane (list below), NTP, DNS. For non-egress (air-gapped) installs, let us know network segmentation and whether a proxy is required.

Minimal network policy (summary):
- Outbound: TCP 443 to control-plane.redwood.ai (we'll provide IP ranges), TCP 123 for NTP, UDP/TCP 53 for DNS.
- Access: Optional bastion (SSH 22) for initial install; we also support agentless installs via your orchestration.
- Ports: 9000/tcp for metrics ingestion only if you opt into push metrics; application traffic remains inside your VPC.

Operational info we need: expected tokens/sec, retention window (logs/metrics), SSO provider (SAML/OIDC), and any compliance evidence required (SOC 2 artifacts, encryption attestations).

Proposed next steps:
1) Fill preflight spreadsheet and return by EOD Mon 2/23.
2) Priya will share an IAM role template and a simple CloudFormation/Terraform snippet for role creation.
3) Schedule a 30-min preflight call — propose Mon 2/23 10:00-10:30 PT or Tue 2/24 14:00-14:30 PT.

Attachments: r_inf-preflight-checklist.xlsx (please edit), network-diagram-vpc.pdf

Thanks — I’ll coordinate internally once we have the completed sheet.

—
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Thanks Dev — got the attachments and initial ask. A few clarifying questions before I send the sheet to our infra team: 
1) For air-gapped on-prem (option c), do you require any outbound connections at all? Our security team prefers fully isolated installs — what capabilities are limited in that mode?
2) For egress you mentioned control plane redwood endpoints — can you provide CIDR blocks or DoH hostnames so we can whitelist?
3) Do you have GPU sizing guidance per expected tokens/sec? We are trying to estimate hardware procurement.

I can do the Monday slot but will need our infra lead (Sam Patel) on the call — he’s out Monday morning until 11:00 PT. If the team can do 11:30 PT Monday that would work.

Alex

alex.green@finnova.com | +1 212-555-8410

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@finnova.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, priya.natarajan@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 10:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Edge-Hosted Private Deploy: Preflight & Account Setup Action Plan

Alex — great questions. Quick answers inline and below to share with your infra/security teams.

1) Air-gapped installs: we support a fully air-gapped on-prem package, but feature tradeoffs apply: no automatic control-plane telemetry, manual model updates, and limited usage analytics. We can run the inference runtime entirely inside your network. For auditing, we provide an on-site collection bundle you can pull for SOC reviews.

2) Control plane egress: for standard private (customer-VPC) deployments we require outbound HTTPS from the runtime to a small set of control endpoints for health checks, cluster management, and billing/usage telemetry. We will provide an IP-range manifest during onboarding and can also accept FQDN whitelists (control-plane.redwood.ai, updates.redwood.ai). For now, please plan to allow outbound TCP 443 to control-plane.redwood.ai and updates.redwood.ai; we’ll share a CIDR manifest before the install.

3) GPU sizing guidance (very high level):
- 20–50 tokens/sec (short context): single A10G / similar per 4 concurrent users.
- 200–500 tokens/sec: consider 4x A10G or 1x A100-class depending on model size and latency SLO.
We’ll run a short load-profile test to finalize. Please fill in expected tokens/sec in the sheet and we’ll map to model & quantization recommendations via Redwood Optimize.

Firewall/ports summary we recommend sharing with your security team:
- Outbound TCP 443 to control-plane.redwood.ai (and updates.redwood.ai)
- TCP/UDP 53 to your DNS resolver
- UDP/TCP 123 for NTP
- Optional: TCP 22 for SSH bastion access during install (we can also support temporary port-forwarded sessions)
- Optional: TCP 9000 for metrics (if you opt in) — otherwise metrics remain internal and we’ll provide aggregated reports.

I’ve also uploaded a pre-populated copy of the preflight (sheet tab "Redwood baseline") to the Drive link in the email. If you confirm 11:30 PT Monday, we’ll book the slot and Priya will share the IAM template prior to the call.

—
Dev

Internal note only — looping you both so we can be prepared for the contract/ops ask during onboarding call. Items to decide: 
- Trial SLA credit: FinNova will want a short SLA window during migration; recommend offering a 30-day migration SLA credit (5% monthly credit) contingent on completion of our standard checklist.
- Canary rollout: Dev/Priya please prepare a 3-step canary: dev -> staging (small percent traffic) -> prod with automatic fallback to hosted models if latency/err rate exceeds thresholds. Document those thresholds and rollback steps.
- Evidence pack: Rishi, please assemble the SOC2 evidence pointers we can hand to FinNova (logging, encryption at rest/in transit, KMS/HSM integration notes).

I’ll surface the credit recommendation in the call if you both approve.

—Marissa

I also attached a pre-populated preflight (r_inf-preflight-checklist.xlsx) with Redwood baseline values — feel free to overwrite.

- Add a security group allowing outbound 443 to control-plane.redwood.ai.
- If using KMS, grant Encrypt/Decrypt to RedwoodOnboardRole; if using HSM, please share contact and network ACLs.
